Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a '''unit''' of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was under [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] command. The unit was involved in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], during which [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick was revealed to be a traitor to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
